concerns.text: T006's body explicitly permits an honest negative result ('If after honest tuning SC-006 still fails, record the negative result'), but the verification requires 'pytest code/tests/test_train_regressor_metrics.py passes, asserting val_mse < 0.9 * baseline_mse'. If SC-006 legitimately fails, the task is UNEXECUTABLE as specified — the implementer cannot both record a negative result and pass the test. Rewrite the test to assert consistency with metrics.json's meets_sc006 flag (and correct arithmetic vs baseline) rather than hard-coding a pass.

T005 says 'roll out ... for a fixed number of episodes (fixed seeds)' but never names the episode count or the seed values. The implementer cannot deterministically execute or budget this (50 clips × 12 grid pairs × N episodes of robosuite rollouts must fit the 6h/7GB budget of T010). Specify N (e.g., a concrete episode count) or name where it is configured, so the runtime feasibility check is computable.

T012 requires 'Re-running must produce identical SHA-256 hashes for all generated artifacts' but T005/T008 involve real robosuite rollouts whose episode logs/CSVs may embed timestamps or nondeterministic env state; the task does not say how nondeterministic fields are excluded from hashing. Also, T012 forbids the manifest 'under state/' while the constitution requires every data/ file checksummed in the state yaml artifact_hashes map — the implementer gets contradictory instructions. Clarify which artifacts are hashed and reconcile with the constitution's state-yaml requirement.

Verification runs 'python -m src.pipeline.validate_autocwm' but all scripts live under code/src/pipeline/ per the header; the command only works with cwd=code/. Specify the working directory (e.g., 'cd code && python -m src.pipeline.validate_autocwm') so the check is reproducible.
